assessment: This important work presents evidence that evolved biophysical compatibility between T cell receptors (TCRs) and MHC molecules is possible and a potential solution to the question of how TCRs could be biased towards MHC proteins given the massive diversity in both receptor and ligand. The evidence supporting the claims of the authors is solid, although the nature of these evolutionary questions makes it difficult to confidently answer some of the raised questions. The work will be of interest to immunologists, structural biologists, and evolutionary biologists.
